scope: Existing ordinary Linux checkout; native TypeScript/Effect development, scoped Python and graph checks, and local development feedback.
conceptual_delta: Make the existing native CLI persistently reachable and preserve installed research tools during locked environment synchronization. No canonical schema, responsibility owner, typed reference, transition, or learning law changes.
claim_ceiling: Engineering environment and bounded development observations only; not HSWM cognition, canonical admission, causal credit, efficacy, FCL passage, or full CI equivalence.
worktree_scope: Checks ran on the local worktree with pre-existing user research edits retained. Artifact bindings below identify selected environment/configuration sources, not the entire runtime source closure.

official_sources.use: locked sync, inexact retention, and no-sync execution
scoped resource management for the existing Effect runtime

installed_toolchain.name: npm
installed_toolchain.pin: src/hswm/effect-runtime/package.json packageManager and CI version check

installed_toolchain.name: uv
installed_toolchain.pin: existing installed version matches graph requalification CI; no new binary download

changes: Installed user-local hswm-dev and hswm-live wrappers that exec the existing checkout launchers; verified both from a fresh login shell.
Ran root locked dev sync with --inexact, preserving 33 extra packages that exact-sync dry-run would remove.
Synchronized the separate graph runtime with its checked-in lock and graph extra; both Python environments pass uv pip check.
Rebuilt the native runtime and DNRD build from existing locked dependencies; added current setup/verification guidance and a contributor entrypoint.

validation.skip_reason: Existing external Temporal/Neo4j integration opt-ins were not enabled.

validation.note: Invocation must use package working directory; an initial root --prefix attempt returned ENOENT and was corrected.

validation.command: uv run --project _research/graph_standards/runtime --locked --extra graph pytest -q tests/test_graph_standard_tooling.py tests/test_research_evidence_graph_view.py tests/test_kg_bundle_graph_view.py tests/test_hypergraph_projection_validation.py tests/test_fractal_learning_plan_projection.py tests/test_standard_graph_view.py tests/test_trace_context.py
uv run python scripts/compile_portable_markdown_math.py README.md INDEX.md docs/canon docs/research ontology

hswm_development_workflow.feedback_authority: agent(codex): explicit usefulness judgments, not user feedback or automatic rewards from exit code
hswm_development_workflow.privacy: Task, selected relation, raw output, episode IDs, results and feedback remain in ignored local workspace state; no SQLite or private run transcript is embedded here.
hswm_development_workflow.coverage_note: Profile counts overlap broader checks and must not be summed. The ontology profile checks existing development KG tools; this new snapshot separately receives JSON and source-digest validation.

limitations: External LLM calls, remote database publication, GPU workloads and full GitHub CI matrix were not exercised.
Node 24.13.0 node:sqlite remains an explicitly experimental local API.
Existing unrelated user changes and prior feedback-pending episodes were preserved.
No dependency upgrades, new external services, plugins, or scientific research mechanisms were introduced.
